cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've put your umbrella back in the stand. You'll want it for work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it wet? It hasn't rained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I gave it a rinse. I'll dry the handle before you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's pondweed caught in the spokes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it needs another rinse. Have breakfast; I'll get it back in the stand properly this time.

mechanism: A controls permission for questions and the restoration process so evidence of misuse becomes another maintenance task rather than a disclosure.
confusable: D14 avoids a topic generally; D37 must actively return or restore a specific item while concealing why restoration became necessary.
comparison: A wet umbrella is repeatedly cleaned before work; the other alternative replaces a mismatched plate without explaining the original loss.
seedUse: D37-a already joins question deferral and directed breakfast with active umbrella restoration, making a retained combined scene plausible.
